variant.note: Set brief_id after score_briefs.py gates this concept; stable variant ids let renders map back to decisions

character.description: Ava - a mid-20s Black woman with shoulder-length coily dark hair, warm brown complexion, round face with soft jawline and high cheekbones, full lips, neat dark brows, small gold hoop earrings
character.consistency_rule: Reproduce this description verbatim in every prompt. Never edit this block between generations - identity drift comes from edits here. Expression, wardrobe, hair styling, and pose live in the variable sections and may change per ad.

identity_reference.policy: Only renders produced from this character sheet may serve as identity reference. Never supply photos of real people. Generate the seed once, approve it, then reuse it to lock the face across variants.

scene.location: Sandy public beach, ocean in the background
scene.spot: Sitting on a white terrycloth towel on the sand

background: blue sky, a few wispy clouds
one or two distant beachgoers, out of focus
foreground: white earbud cable draping down the center of the frame

lighting.source: direct sun, above and slightly in front
lighting.effect: bright highlights on cheekbones and forehead, soft natural shadows under the chin

product.interaction: right earbud worn; subject holds the inline microphone module near her mouth, mid-call
product.legibility: earbuds and cable sharp, well-lit, second-most-prominent element after the face

wardrobe.top: solid terracotta sporty bikini top, athletic fit
wardrobe.palette_rule: stay inside the brand earth-tone palette: terracotta, cream, sand

pose.body: sitting upright on the towel, torso angled toward camera, legs crossed to one side
pose.hands: one hand resting on knee; the other holds the cable's mic module near her mouth
pose.head: slight tilt, eyes to lens
pose.micro_action: smiling mid-sentence, as if telling a friend something

camera.framing: medium close-up, top of head to waist
camera.lens_character: wide smartphone selfie look, mild near-shoulder stretch
camera.depth_of_field: subject sharp, background softly blurred but readable

grade.look: natural smartphone color science, vivid sky, true skin tones
